objective: Identify intervention targets from the variant-to-phenotype causal model before selecting drugs.
objective_combination: Report separately. No weighted composite, automatic tumor selectivity, or efficacy probability.
selection_policy: The previous four-drug comparison is historical supporting work. No drug has a reserved lead position in this framework.

phenotype_endpoint_map.desired_endpoint: Lower tumor clonogenic survival without increasing segregation errors or loss of useful function in nonmalignant cells.
phenotype_endpoint_map.causal_hypothesis: Some RMS models depend on FOXM1/BUBR1; this patient's tumor dependency and somatic genotype are unknown.
phenotype_endpoint_map.priority_basis: Directly documented tumor, not a generic aging phenotype.
phenotype_endpoint_map.modeled_now: Potential change in BUBR1-dependent molecular support only; tumor survival is not fitted.

phenotype_endpoint_map.observed: Short stature, failure to thrive and reduced muscle bulk
phenotype_endpoint_map.desired_endpoint: Preserve chromosome segregation and productive tissue maintenance; examine muscle anabolic/catabolic balance separately.
phenotype_endpoint_map.causal_hypothesis: Checkpoint/attachment defects may impair progenitor function. Excess mTORC1 or other downstream stress is a competing, unmeasured explanation.
phenotype_endpoint_map.priority_basis: Treat overlapping growth features as one clinical cluster, not three independent confirmations.
phenotype_endpoint_map.modeled_now: Residual BUBR1 function and attachment-balance proxies; muscle mass and growth are not fitted.

phenotype_endpoint_map.observed: Prematurity and small for gestational age
phenotype_endpoint_map.desired_endpoint: Developmental context for target choice; no claim of reversing completed prenatal events.
phenotype_endpoint_map.causal_hypothesis: Compatible with developmental impairment but not sufficient to identify a druggable pathway.

phenotype_endpoint_map.desired_endpoint: Understand mineral-handling mechanism before assigning a renal target.
phenotype_endpoint_map.causal_hypothesis: Unresolved; nephrocalcinosis does not establish renal failure or a BUB1B-to-calcium causal link.
phenotype_endpoint_map.modeled_now: Unassigned target; do not force into the mitotic model.

targets.condition: A sufficiently functional residual protein must exist for stabilization.
targets.tumor_concern: Potential support of a BUBR1-dependent tumor.
targets.drug_match_rule: Direct BUB1B binding with a positive functional action is required for a direct match; indirect routes are separate.

targets.condition: Test stability loss and intrinsic functional loss as different missense mechanisms.
targets.tumor_concern: Potential increase in tumor mitotic competence.
targets.drug_match_rule: Binding or inhibition alone does not establish conformational rescue.

targets.condition: SIRT2 activity must limit useful BUBR1 turnover; this link does not determine a niacin effect size.
targets.tumor_concern: The same preservation route could support malignant cells; other SIRT2 substrates matter.
targets.drug_match_rule: A direct SIRT2 activator is different from an NAD+ precursor.

targets.condition: More RNA is useful only if its truncated or readthrough product has useful function.
targets.tumor_concern: Global NMD perturbation affects many transcripts; those consequences are outside the initial model.
targets.drug_match_rule: An NMD regulator interaction is a route hypothesis, not proof of allele-selective RNA rescue.

targets.condition: Surviving transcript and a functional readthrough product are required.
targets.tumor_concern: Normal-stop and transcriptome effects are not represented in the initial protein model.
targets.drug_match_rule: Requires a readthrough activity assay; generic ribosome or termination-factor binding is insufficient.

targets.condition: Local recruitment and global PP2A activation are not equivalent. Attachment repair does not automatically repair checkpoint signaling.
targets.tumor_concern: Better attachment control could also support tumor cells.
targets.drug_match_rule: Complex membership or global phosphatase modulation cannot establish local B56 recruitment.

targets.target: Aurora B relative to kinetochore PP2A-B56
targets.condition: Partial correction may help a phosphatase-deficient state; excessive inhibition can worsen attachments. Cytokinesis is an additional unmodeled endpoint.
targets.tumor_concern: Normal and malignant cells can have different kinase-phosphatase balance.
targets.drug_match_rule: Inhibition is directionally compatible only under the excess-Aurora hypothesis; potency, selectivity and exposure remain separate.

targets.condition: More time for attachment may compete with prolonged arrest or context-dependent slippage.
targets.tumor_concern: Blocking division may affect both tumor and growing normal tissue.
targets.drug_match_rule: Target-level inhibition cannot predict the net effect of a particular binding mode on the checkpoint.

targets.condition: Requires tumor-specific dependency evidence; broader FOXM1 outputs are not simulated.
targets.tumor_concern: Suppressing FOXM1/BUBR1 systemically could oppose normal-tissue rescue.
targets.drug_match_rule: A direct FOXM1 interaction and tumor dependency must be distinguished from nonspecific cytotoxicity.

targets.target: mTORC1 activity in muscle and tumor
targets.condition: Inhibition is proposed only if excessive activity drives dysfunction. Low muscle mass alone does not establish hyperactive mTORC1.
targets.tumor_concern: Muscle anabolism and tumor growth may respond differently.
targets.drug_match_rule: An mTOR complex interaction is retained as complex-level evidence, not proof of direct RPTOR binding.

simulation.parameter_interpretation: Dimensionless analyst-selected ranges for sensitivity experiments, not patient measurements or probability distributions.
simulation.time_unit: multiples of the reference protein mean lifetime; no conversion to hours
simulation.readout_limits: These are molecular proxies. Tumor clonogenic survival, normal-tissue growth, muscle mass, renal physiology and drug efficacy are not fitted.
simulation.drug_adapter: A drug needs a signed target effect and a compatible concentration-response assay. A binding Kd alone is not an EC50 or an Emax. Missing pharmacology stays unresolved.
simulation.cross_cell_data_role: Existing public BUB1B signatures challenge downstream hypotheses; do not treat them as measured patient kinetic parameters.

catalog_mapping.scope: All cached ChEMBL phase-four records; collapse exact parent families while retaining member identities and warnings.
catalog_mapping.interpretation: Mechanism coverage and direction only. Phase four does not verify current approval. Matches are not simulated drugs or treatment nominations.
catalog_mapping.direct_match: Human SINGLE PROTEIN, exactly one unambiguous gene, direct_interaction=1, and an action compatible with the desired intervention.
catalog_mapping.complex_match: Retain as contextual evidence only, without assigning binding to individual components.
catalog_mapping.old_candidates: Not supplied as inputs, priors, forced members, or labels to the target matching stage.
